# Official CAD authoring grammar
Authority: Caemble app contract. Manuals: /doc?help=manual&item=reference-core-api and /doc?help=geometry.

## Complete experiment.tsx skeleton
```tsx
import { experiment } from '@caemble/core'
import { StarterStructure } from './geometry'
import { StarterMaterial } from './material'

export default experiment({
  lengthUnit: 'mm',
  varsSchema: {
    sizeX: { min: 36, max: 36 },
    sizeY: { min: 24, max: 24 },
    sizeZ: { min: 12, max: 12 },
    position: { shape: [3], min: -5, max: 5 },
  },
  geometry: ({ vars }) => (
    <StarterStructure
      id="starter"
      size={[vars.sizeX, vars.sizeY, vars.sizeZ]}
      position={vars.position}
      materials={{ body: StarterMaterial }}
    />
  ),
  recordedData: {},
})
```

## Complete geometry.tsx skeleton
```tsx
import { Box, type Geometry, type Vec3 } from '@caemble/core'

export const StarterStructure: Geometry<{ size: Vec3 }> = ({ size = [36, 24, 12] }) => (
  <Box size={size} />
)
```

## Authoring conventions
- A scalar `varsSchema` entry uses `{ min, max }`; omitted `shape` defaults to `[]`, and explicit `shape: []` remains valid. Tensors require an explicit shape such as `[3]` or `[4, 4, 1]`.
- New code uses canonical transforms: `position?: Vec3`, `rotation?: Vec3`, `scale?: Vec3`. Right-handed intrinsic XYZ Euler angles in radians, matching the Three/R3F default XYZ order. Effective order: scale, rotation, position.
- Group transforms use lowercase `<translate offset={Vec3}>`, `<rotate axis={Vec3} angle={radians(degrees)}>`, and `<scale x={sx} y={sy} z={sz}>`.
- Omitted component/primitive IDs use lower-kebab names plus `-2`, `-3`; use explicit stable IDs for durable targets. Fragment has no `id`.
- A topology-changing operation owns its result `id`; consumed operand IDs are not final solver targets. `array` keeps `$cell-x-y-z` instance identity.
- `surfaceGroup` members use `<geometry-id>/surface/<index>`. Give referenced primitive/Fiber leaves stable IDs and use the numeric slots from the Element reference. Transforms and Boolean results retain source slots. Hyperboloid and Paraboloid have only side 1 and top 2; no vertex cap or slot 0.
- Components inherit the parent Material role map when `materials` is omitted; an explicit map replaces it and `{}` clears it. Primitives consume the `body` role.
- Boolean child order defines the operation: `subtract` uses the first child as base and the rest as cutters.
- Import PascalCase primitives and public APIs from `@caemble/core`; keep operation tags lowercase. Export PascalCase named `Geometry<Props>` components, never a default Geometry export.
- Local `Geometry<Props>` functions use direct destructuring with an initializer for every custom prop; no `props.foo`, rest, computed, or nested patterns.
- Follow each primitive required/default property declaration. The four focal/aspheric primitives require their defining dimensions. Optional omitted/`undefined` props use declared defaults. Operation props and child contracts stay required.
- Fiber uses a continuous Line/Arc path and a constant radius or physical arc-length radiusProfile. Shape definitions are separate from tessellation. CAD shell, curvedSurfaceSphere and sampled/procedural Fiber inputs were removed; migrate source and rebuild.
- `for`, `map`, and `if` are supported. Use explicit loop IDs; prefer `array` for regular lattices.

## Element index (canonical syntax)
- `Box`: `<Box size={[x,y,z]} />`
- `Cylinder`: `<Cylinder radius={r1} radius_2={r2} height={h} segments={32} />`
- `CurvedEdgeCylinder`: `<CurvedEdgeCylinder height={h} azimuthalCurve={modes} verticalCurve={{origin,coefficients}} />`
- `Sphere`: `<Sphere radius={r} segments={32} />`
- `Fiber`: `<Fiber from={p0} to={p1} radius={r} />`
- `translate`: `<translate offset={[x,y,z]}>Geometry...</translate>`
- `rotate`: `<rotate axis={[x,y,z]} angle={radians(degrees)}>Geometry...</rotate>`
- `scale`: `<scale x={sx} y={sy} z={sz}>Geometry...</scale>`
- `array`: `<array shape={[nx,ny,nz]} period={[px,py,pz]} axes={{x,y,z}} inject={tensors}>Geometry</array>`
- `union`: `<union>...</union>`
- `subtract`: `<subtract>base cutter...</subtract>`
- `intersect`: `<intersect>shapeA shapeB...</intersect>`
- `AsphericCylinder`: `<AsphericCylinder id="body" radius={5} centerThickness={2} />`
- `Ellipsoid`: `<Ellipsoid id="body" focalDistance={3} axialRadius={5} />`
- `Hyperboloid`: `<Hyperboloid id="body" focalDistance={5} axialRadius={3} radius={4} />`
- `Paraboloid`: `<Paraboloid id="body" focalLength={3} radius={4} />`

properties.name: height
properties.description: Z축 방향의 전체 높이입니다.

properties.name: azimuthalCurve
properties.description: 방위각 방향 Fourier mode 배열입니다.

properties.name: verticalCurve
properties.description: origin과 coefficients로 높이별 Taylor 반지름 배율을 정의합니다.

properties.name: azimuthalSegments
properties.description: 방위각 방향 분할 수입니다.

properties.name: verticalSegments
properties.description: 높이 방향 분할 수입니다.

elements.origin: 중심이 원점에 있고 기본 축은 +Z이며 양 끝은 z = ±height/2에 있습니다.
elements.example: <CurvedEdgeCylinder id="body" height={20} azimuthalCurve={[{ amplitude: 5, phase: 0 }]} verticalCurve={{ origin: 0, coefficients: [1] }} />

properties.name: radius
properties.description: 구 반지름입니다.

properties.name: segments
properties.description: 표면 분할 해상도입니다.

elements.summary: Line/Arc 중심선과 호 길이에 따른 연속 반경 profile로 닫힌 solid를 만듭니다.

properties.name: from
properties.description: Straight centerline start. Mutually exclusive with path.

properties.name: to
properties.description: Straight centerline end. Mutually exclusive with path.

properties.name: radius
properties.description: Positive constant radius in scene length units. Mutually exclusive with radiusProfile.

properties.name: path
properties.description: Continuous centerline. Line {kind:'line',length}; Arc {kind:'arc',radius,angle,normal}. Each inherits the preceding endpoint/tangent. Signed angles are radians and normal is the local bending-plane normal.

properties.name: radiusProfile
properties.description: Positive radius knots at strictly increasing physical arc lengths s, spanning 0 through the full path length. Piecewise linear interpolation preserves slope creases.

properties.name: tessellation
properties.description: Mesh only. pathSegments >= 1 and radialSegments >= 3. Segment and radius-profile boundaries are always sampled.

elements.origin: 입력한 경로 좌표를 유지합니다. 자동으로 재중심화하지 않습니다.

elements.summary: 한 개 이상의 child Geometry를 parent 좌표계에서 상대 이동합니다.

properties.name: offset
properties.description: parent 좌표계에서 적용할 XYZ 상대 이동입니다.

children.description: 동일한 상대 이동을 적용할 Geometry를 한 개 이상 받습니다.

elements.origin: child의 local 좌표계를 유지한 채 offset만큼 이동합니다.

elements.summary: 한 개 이상의 child Geometry를 원점 기준 axis-angle로 회전합니다.

properties.name: angle
properties.description: radian 단위의 회전각입니다. degree 입력은 radians()로 변환합니다.

children.description: 동일한 axis-angle 회전을 적용할 Geometry를 한 개 이상 받습니다.

elements.origin: wrapper local 원점을 중심으로 오른손 axis-angle 회전을 적용합니다.

elements.summary: Conic and even-polynomial faces joined by a cylindrical side. Full-aperture positive thickness is certified independently of tessellation.

properties.name: radius
properties.description: Positive maximum radial aperture in scene length units.

properties.name: centerThickness
properties.description: Positive vertex separation h. Bottom vertex is -h/2; top vertex is +h/2.

properties.name: top
properties.description: Top sag along +Z: c*rho^2/(1+sqrt(1-(1+k)*c^2*rho^2)) + sum(A_n*rho^n). Unique even n >= 4. Omitted face is planar.

properties.name: bottom
properties.description: Bottom sag uses the same +Z sign and coefficient convention as top. Omitted face is planar.

properties.name: tessellation
properties.description: Mesh only: radialSegments >= 3 (default 64), meridianSegments >= 2 (default 32). Analysis applies its refinement profile.

elements.origin: Local Z axis; vertices at -centerThickness/2 and +centerThickness/2. No recentering.

elements.summary: Prolate ellipsoid defined by a focus pair; focalDistance=0 gives a sphere.

properties.name: focalDistance
properties.description: Half the focus separation, f >= 0. Foci are [0,0,+/-f].

properties.name: axialRadius
properties.description: Axial semiaxis a > f. Transverse semiaxis is sqrt(a^2-f^2).

properties.name: tessellation
properties.description: Mesh only: radialSegments >= 3 (default 64), meridianSegments >= 2 (default 32). Analysis applies its refinement profile.

elements.origin: The focus midpoint is the origin; Z vertices are +/-axialRadius. No caps.

elements.summary: Positive-Z branch of a two-sheet hyperboloid, closed by a disk at the maximum radius.

properties.name: focalDistance
properties.description: Half the focus separation f > a > 0; foci [0,0,+/-f].

properties.name: axialRadius
properties.description: Positive vertex coordinate a; transverse scale b=sqrt(f^2-a^2).

properties.name: radius
properties.description: Positive maximum radius r. Top height is a*sqrt(1+r^2/b^2); solid height is zTop-a. No Z clipping input.

properties.name: tessellation
properties.description: Mesh only: radialSegments >= 3 (default 64), meridianSegments >= 2 (default 32). Analysis applies its refinement profile.

elements.origin: The focus midpoint remains the origin; vertex [0,0,a]. Surface 1 is curved; 2 is the top disk. There is no surface 0.

elements.summary: Rotational paraboloid z=rho^2/(4*f), closed by a disk at maximum radius.

properties.name: focalLength
properties.description: Positive focal length f; focus [0,0,f], vertex [0,0,0].

properties.name: radius
properties.description: Positive maximum radius r. Top height is r^2/(4*f). No Z clipping input.

properties.name: tessellation
properties.description: Mesh only: radialSegments >= 3 (default 64), meridianSegments >= 2 (default 32). Analysis applies its refinement profile.

elements.origin: Vertex at origin, opening +Z. Surface 1 is curved; 2 is the top disk. There is no surface 0.
